about_the_game:
Show your support for the Capcom Pro Tour with the Capcom Pro Tour 2018 Premier Pass.

Includes the following content: Sakura CPT 2018 Costume, Akuma CPT 2018 Costume, PS4-exclusive EX colors for 34 characters (all sixteen launch characters and 18 Season 1, Season 2, and Season 3 DLC characters), two CPT 2018 Fighter Profile themes, five special in-game titles, and a bonus of 5,000 Fight Money.

This package also includes Birdie's CPT 2018 Champion's Choice costume and 'Ring of Power' stage

*The costumes and stage included in this bundle can be purchased individually. Please be careful of duplicate purchases.
*In order to use the CPT 2018 costumes and CPT: 2018 Premier Pass EX05 colors, you will also need access to the characters.
*The EX05 colors, in-game titles and fighter profile themes are limited content only available in the CPT: 2018 Premier Pass. These contents are not available for purchase individually.
*In order to use this content, it is required to have the base game which is sold separately. Also, please make sure to update when it is required to apply the latest patch.
